dayModeHighlights.title: Golden Daylight Delta
dayModeHighlights.desc: Vibrant sunlit paddy fields, buzzing river ghats, green tea slopes, and active commercial ports.

dayModeHighlights.title: River Highways
dayModeHighlights.desc: Hundreds of traditional paddle boats, high-speed launches, and country cargo boats traversing 700+ rivers.

dayModeHighlights.title: Cultural Colors
dayModeHighlights.desc: Rickshaw painting workshops, Nakshi Kantha needlework, and lively bazaar morning rush.

nightModeHighlights.title: Illuminated Night Skylines
nightModeHighlights.desc: The glowing architectural silhouettes of Hatirjheel, Padma Bridge, and Chattogram Sea Port under starry skies.

nightModeHighlights.title: Serene River Night Cruising
nightModeHighlights.desc: Multi-deck passenger launches gliding across the quiet shimmering waters of the Meghna and Padma.

nightModeHighlights.title: Enchanted Wilderness
nightModeHighlights.desc: Nocturnal calls of the Sundarbans mangrove forest and glittering fireflies across rural Bengal.
